wish: someone should make a tool that draws Venn diagrams
spec:
Draws a labeled 2- or 3-set Venn diagram from set names and item lists, placing each item in the region it belongs to.
Type names and comma- or line-separated items; the diagram and a region-by-region list update as you type; optionally scale circles to set sizes; save as SVG or PNG.
Does not draw 4 or more sets, and scaled 3-set layouts are approximate.
notes: Up to 3 sets. 'Scale to size' makes circle areas proportional to set sizes; 3-set overlaps are approximate.
